sluice_001.speaker: narrator
sluice_001.text: Three days after the mountain steadied, Lin Yue tried to lift a kettle with qi. Nothing moved. The copper wick answered her next admission, faintly and briefly, exactly as before. She sat beside the cold kettle until shame became specific: she had mistaken surviving beside powerful people for becoming one. Then she carried the kettle to the stove with both hands.

sluice_002.speaker: shen_qing
sluice_002.text: The valley commission will wait for the drainage survey. Yun has put repair engineers on the displaced roads, and they need more than a week. You can travel with us when those routes open. Until then, the lower sluice pays for sorting salt crust from its grounding beds. Han Mei says the work includes instruction, if you want it.

sluice_003.speaker: lin_yue
sluice_003.text: I want instruction. I also want to know whether the wage pays for it, or whether someone will tell me afterward that the lessons were a favor. At the kiln, a favor sometimes cost more than a debt. If I cannot afford the practice circle, I would rather discover that before I promise to become useful.

sluice_004.speaker: narrator
sluice_004.text: Han Mei walked her down a covered path to pools that reflected the floating mountain in broken squares. Copper coils hung beside ordinary rakes. The sluice gates had no aura at all; they were lifted with chains and a winch. Beside the workbench, a gray-haired man inspected a wooden leg brace before putting his weight on it.

sluice_005.speaker: duan_zhi
sluice_005.text: Duan Zhi. Six paired routes on my best recovered day, fewer when the knee swells. I examine beginners and maintain the east grounding bed. Your wage is six copper marks for a full shift. Instruction is part of my paid duty. Practice fuel is charged separately, at the posted share. Read the board before you choose a bed.

sluice_006.speaker: narrator
sluice_006.text: The board priced meals, a dry sleeping mat, and two supervised quarter-hours. It also listed a recovery allowance that could not be spent on practice fuel. Lin Yue counted the columns twice. After food and lodging, she could afford three sessions in five days if she took no extra shifts. She had imagined a sect treasury too large to notice her hunger.

sluice_007.speaker: han_mei
sluice_007.text: Keep the recovery allowance. You will be tempted to buy another quarter-hour with it because a new sensation feels close. Close is not a price. This sluice has buried one worker who practiced through a fever. His family still receives part of our repair levy. We put the allowance beyond the instructor's reach after that.

sluice_008.speaker: narrator
sluice_008.text: Lin Yue chose a dry mat beneath a window that would not shut. Her pendant went into the same wooden box as her spare socks. For a moment she waited for a hidden voice to correct the arithmetic. The jade held only the offered memory she already knew. She wrapped it against scratches and returned to the wage board.

sluice_009.speaker: duan_zhi
sluice_009.text: Stage one proves that a trace can remain. Stage two proves that retention is reliable through ordinary life. A novice can close a reservoir while sitting still, then lose most of it climbing stairs or sleeping. We will measure what leaves you. We will also measure what the instrument loses. Otherwise you may train harder to repair a leak in my copper.

sluice_010.speaker: narrator
sluice_010.text: He set two capped chambers on the bench. One held a reference trace supplied by the workshop's stone; the other was blank. He swapped their positions behind a folded cloth. Lin Yue felt warmth from the left chamber and pointed to it. Duan uncovered both. The left was empty. Morning sun had warmed its copper shell.

sluice_011.speaker: duan_zhi
sluice_011.text: That is useful. Now we know your skin notices temperature before your attention notices refined qi. It is a good skin doing its ordinary work. Do not punish it for disagreeing with your ambition. Shade both vessels, wait until their temperatures match, and tell me what remains. You may answer that you cannot distinguish them.

sluice_012.speaker: narrator
sluice_012.text: After the vessels cooled, Lin Yue guessed incorrectly twice and refused to guess the third time. Duan wrote all three results. The refusal occupied its own line rather than being counted as failure or success. She disliked that blank line more than the crosses. It looked like a small space where a miraculous future should have announced itself.

sluice_013.speaker: lin_yue
sluice_013.text: When the wick lit on the terrace, I knew exactly where the trace went. Here I keep reaching for the sensation I remember. It is like trying to find a bowl in a dark room by recalling the bowl's color. Could I follow the release stroke instead of looking for the light at the beginning?

sluice_014.speaker: duan_zhi
sluice_014.text: Yes. Direction can be easier to test than intensity. Admit less than one breath-unit, send it toward the grounded thread, and stop before the thread completes an exhalation. The chamber records a change only if the blank stays blank. We are separating perception, direction and retention. Combining three uncertain actions does not create one certain result.

sluice_015.speaker: narrator
sluice_015.text: At noon, her chamber changed by less than half a marked interval. The blank did not change. Duan repeated the test with the vessels reversed, then had her walk to the gate and back. The second reading was smaller. The workshop had not rejected her. It had found a question precise enough that practice might eventually answer it.

sluice_016.speaker: narrator
sluice_016.text: That afternoon the winch needed six ordinary turns for every handspan of gate rise. Lin Yue's arms remembered the kiln before her dantian remembered anything. She sorted salt chips into baskets by size, refusing the urge to send qi into the rake. A damaged grounding bed could carry spent workshop power into the workers' boots. Her ignorance was part of the load.

sluice_017.speaker: han_mei
sluice_017.text: The white crust is mostly ordinary salt. The gray grains trap incompatible remnants from the practice circles. Put those in the lined tray. They are not a cultivation treasure just because they hold energy. Swallowing them would be like drinking the water from a washbasin because someone important washed there. The disposal fee pays for keeping that mistake out of someone's dinner.

sluice_018.speaker: narrator
sluice_018.text: By evening, gray grains had gathered under her fingernails. Han Mei checked her gloves and showed her the small split at one seam. Lin Yue replaced them from the workshop rack, then entered the replacement on the board. The charge was for careless damage only. Worn equipment belonged to the work's cost, a distinction she had never seen honored at the kiln.

sluice_019.speaker: narrator
sluice_019.text: Her first overnight trial began with three breath-units. Duan measured immediately after admission, again after supper, and once more before sleep. Each reading required a small discharge, which he entered separately. Lin Yue tried to add the numbers in her head and found she had made the reservoir seem smaller by counting the measurement loss twice.

sluice_020.speaker: duan_zhi
sluice_020.text: Initial reserve minus known work, minus measurement discharge, gives the reserve we expect. Compare that with what remains. Leakage is the unexplained difference. We cannot make the discharge vanish merely because it is inconvenient. An examination that spends power is part of the experiment, not an invisible witness standing outside it.

sluice_021.speaker: narrator
sluice_021.text: She woke with one breath-unit and a stiff jaw. The trial lost more than its allowance. In dreams she had been holding a door shut against winter wind; waking, she discovered she had clenched her belly as if the dantian were that door. She could still perform a clean release. She could not yet sleep without turning closure into an ordinary muscle cramp.

sluice_022.speaker: lin_yue
sluice_022.text: If I tighten less, the trace escapes. If I tighten more, I wake sore and lose it anyway. There must be a seal between those choices. I keep hearing people say to close the lower field, but a field has soil and banks. Is there an actual bank I am supposed to strengthen?

sluice_023.speaker: duan_zhi
sluice_023.text: The lower dantian is a cultivated junction, not a bladder you squeeze. Its boundary is maintained by compatible circulation and a release route that remains available. Think of a pool with a sound bed and an overflow. Plugging every exit raises pressure until the weakest place becomes an exit. Tonight we practice closure while your hands perform an ordinary task.

sluice_024.speaker: narrator
sluice_024.text: He gave her twelve beans and a bowl. She moved one bean on each natural exhalation, maintaining a quarter-unit trace without changing the breath. When she reached seven, attention narrowed and her thumb shook. Duan ended the trial. The seven beans stayed in the bowl. A stopped exercise could retain its observation without being promoted into a passed examination.

sluice_025.speaker: narrator
sluice_025.text: For six days she practiced with beans, then knots, then the quiet act of washing a cup. Her reserve varied with hunger and the weather. On a cold morning she felt a bright rush that vanished under the shaded-chamber test. By the sixth evening she could keep the same small trace while explaining the test aloud. It was slower progress than the bright rush, and more durable.

sluice_026.speaker: han_mei
sluice_026.text: Do not compare your sixth evening with someone's performance at a festival. You do not know how many days they rested beforehand or how much fuel sits under their shoes. Compare it with your own first evening under the same test. Then change one condition. A skill that survives that change belongs to you more securely than a borrowed applause.

sluice_027.speaker: narrator
sluice_027.text: The sluice offered her an extra shift when a worker went home to care for a child. The money would buy two more sessions. Lin Yue studied her own last three readings: every one after a long shift was worse. The wage was real. So was the tiredness. She needed a way to help without spending the strength she intended to examine.

sluice_028.speaker: lin_yue
sluice_028.text: I can take the morning sorting, or copy the basin records after supper, or leave the shift to someone rested and use tonight for recovery. Each solves a different part of the problem. I want to choose with the measurements in front of me, before I start telling myself that whatever earns more must also cultivate more.

choices.text: Take only the rested morning sorting shift.
Copy the basin records and protect practice time.
Let a rested worker take the shift and recover.

sluice_029.speaker: narrator
sluice_029.text: Whatever she chose, the next scheduled examination stayed on the same morning. Duan would not sell her an earlier attempt merely because she had paid for fuel. He checked her hands, her sleep record and the copper blank. She had begun to understand why a workshop could be full of cultivation instruments and still devote most of its attention to beds, meals and weather.

sluice_030.speaker: duan_zhi
sluice_030.text: The second-stage standard here is six usable breath-units after an ordinary day and a night's sleep, on three recovered trials. Correct for the measured sampling cost. At least four-fifths of the retained charge must follow your compatible cycle. You must discharge to the grounding tail without numbness, and explain a changed reading without blaming your root by default.

sluice_031.speaker: narrator
sluice_031.text: The first qualifying attempt returned five units and three quarters. It was the best reading she had ever made. Lin Yue smiled before Duan finished the entry, then watched him draw a short line beneath the six-unit threshold. He congratulated the improvement and withheld the stage. She walked back to her mat feeling both facts, unwilling to let one erase the other.

sluice_032.speaker: narrator
sluice_032.text: A trader outside the south gate offered her a crimson pellet said to close any beginner's field overnight. Its paper named no ingredients. Lin Yue asked what happened when the pellet wore off. The trader answered by describing a disciple who had reached Foundation before thirty. She held her five-unit result in mind and noticed that her question had not received an answer.

sluice_033.speaker: lin_yue
sluice_033.text: I cannot pay for an unknown seal and a known recovery at the same time. If it hides leakage for one night, I may pass a number and fail the work afterward. I want the ingredient list and the independent tests. Without those, the money remains for food. Five and three quarters is disappointing enough without becoming a mystery.

sluice_034.speaker: narrator
sluice_034.text: She returned empty-handed and found Shen Qing carrying two ordinary sacks of grain. He did not ask whether she had advanced. He asked whether the west pool's water had clouded after yesterday's rain. She answered from the basin records. It was the first useful thing she had told him that week, and it came from attention she had almost sold for a shortcut.

sluice_035.speaker: shen_qing
sluice_035.text: Yun's engineers traced the clouding to a broken rain channel. That matters more today than your largest reserve. Your field will grow if the work is sound. The valley will still need people who can notice a broken channel when everyone is staring at the bright array above it. Keep the grain. It belongs to the workshop's meal account.

sluice_036.speaker: narrator
sluice_036.text: Duan moved the next trial indoors because the storm altered ambient qi. He kept the fuel allotment unchanged and recorded the humidity. Lin Yue practiced the closure with a short ordinary walk between cycles, rather than sitting until her legs went numb. For the first time she could feel the difference between the dantian's quiet circulation and the pressure she made by trying to feel it.

sluice_037.speaker: narrator
sluice_037.text: The morning reading was six and one quarter. Purity was eighty-two parts in a hundred after the reference correction. Her hand remained steady during release. Duan entered the result as the first qualifying trial, then sent her to breakfast. She wanted to practice immediately, as if resting might let the proof escape. The breakfast steam offered no proof at all, only what her body needed.

sluice_038.speaker: narrator
sluice_038.text: On the next recovered trial she retained six units exactly. A rain gust startled her during sampling; she stopped, grounded the instrument, and resumed after the blank settled. Duan counted the interruption in her favor because the safety route had remained available. The field had survived a small disturbance without requiring the world to become silent around her.

sluice_039.speaker: narrator
sluice_039.text: The third trial used a different chamber and a different sleeping room. Han Mei watched the fuel seal while Duan took the readings. Six and one eighth remained after corrections; the compatible fraction was eighty-three percent. Lin Yue released cleanly, then held a cup by its rim without tremor. The ordinary cup made the result harder to argue with than the instrument's jade light.

sluice_040.speaker: duan_zhi
sluice_040.text: Qi Gathering, second stage: Retention. Six units are available on today's recovered test. That is a measured reserve, not an unlimited promise. Your stage records a reliable pattern; illness may interrupt it. You will still keep a discharge margin. Tomorrow we measure the first route's resistance. Tonight you eat, sleep, and let success become something your body can afford.

sluice_work_001.speaker: narrator
sluice_work_001.text: Lin Yue took the morning sorting and stopped at the agreed bell. When the next basket arrived, her hands moved toward it before she remembered the limit. She passed it to the rested worker. The wage bought one future fuel share. Keeping the stopping time protected the recovered examination more effectively than pretending an extra basket would cost no strength.

sluice_work_002.speaker: han_mei
sluice_work_002.text: You finished the assigned work and left the remainder legible. That is help. I can staff a shift around a declared limit; I cannot staff it around someone secretly collapsing. Record the morning's load beside tonight's practice result. If the result changes, we should know which ordinary labor helped produce the change.

sluice_records_001.speaker: narrator
sluice_records_001.text: The copying desk required no lifting, but its dim lamp made her rub her eyes. She moved nearer the window and copied only the promised four pages. A line of unusual turbidity measurements emerged from the work. She circled the dates for the mechanic instead of using their pattern to invent a spiritual obstruction inside herself.

sluice_records_002.speaker: duan_zhi
sluice_records_002.text: Good. A basin can be dirty even when your channels are sound. Keep environmental notes beside bodily notes. Similar symptoms can have different causes, and an expensive treatment for the wrong cause remains the wrong treatment. You have earned the copying wage. The clue earns our inspection, not a higher realm.

sluice_rest_001.speaker: narrator
sluice_rest_001.text: Lin Yue left the extra shift to a rested worker and spent the evening mending her sleeve. Saying no had made her stomach tighten more than a difficult breath exercise. After supper the tightness passed. She slept a full night, then wrote the refusal in her practice record beside the unchanged wage, so that recovery would not vanish from the account.

sluice_rest_002.speaker: han_mei
sluice_rest_002.text: The worker taking that shift wanted its wage and could bear its load. You did not steal a meal by admitting your own limit. We have a roster precisely because every body cannot be available at every bell. If tomorrow's hands are steadier, give the rest its proper credit. It was an action with a cost.

channels_001.speaker: narrator
channels_001.text: Second stage changed the entry in Lin Yue's book and very little else. The gate still needed a winch. Her meals still cost money. When she woke tired after celebrating with sweet rice, her field returned a smaller reserve than on the examination day. She recorded it without crossing out the stage, then asked whether a reliable pattern could include such a day.

channels_002.speaker: duan_zhi
channels_002.text: Reliability includes knowing when the pattern is unavailable. Your recovered capacity and today's usable reserve are different measures. A runner can be trained and still exhausted. Do not spend an examination number you no longer possess. We will begin route work below half of today's measured reserve, leaving enough for a safe discharge and the ordinary walk home.

channels_003.speaker: narrator
channels_003.text: He unfolded a map of the twelve primary channels. Paired strokes connected receiving and returning paths; fine side marks indicated tissue junctions where perception often became confused. Lin Yue searched for the single gate she imagined opening. There were many joints instead. Some appeared twice, under different names, because the same limb needed distinct directions of flow.

channels_004.speaker: duan_zhi
channels_004.text: For your method, the first pair follows the inner wrist route toward the chest junction and its outward partner toward the hand. These are cultivated paths associated with tissue, not hollow pipes waiting to be drilled. We soften resistance with compatible trickles and inspect the return. Forcing a larger flow through numb tissue can make the sensation seem easier while destroying its warning.

channels_005.speaker: narrator
channels_005.text: The bronze caliper had two mineral lenses and separate grounding cords. Duan placed one lens over the practice thread and one over its return. He showed her the tiny delay between them. A matched return appeared after the outgoing trace, never before it. If both brightened together, ambient interference or a faulty bridge was the likelier explanation.

channels_006.speaker: duan_zhi
channels_006.text: This instrument cannot see a soul. It compares a controlled input and an observable return at the surface. It has blind places. We add your report of pressure, the pulse checks and a next-day examination. If those disagree, the bright lens does not win by being expensive. Instruments have limits; practitioners have incentives to misreport. The test needs both facts.

channels_007.speaker: narrator
channels_007.text: Lin Yue borrowed the caliper under a numbered slip. She cleaned its contact pads, inspected the silk cords and returned it before the next novice's session. The tool cost more than she had earned in a year at the kiln. Its price made her afraid to use it until she saw a repaired hinge. Someone trusted ordinary maintenance more than ceremonial perfection.

channels_008.speaker: han_mei
channels_008.text: A clean repaired tool can be safer than a beautiful neglected one. Check the repair before each borrowing. If it drifts, leave a note and take it out of service. Nobody earns a realm by keeping another worker's equipment pristine in imagination. We need to know what it actually does after salt air, wet sleeves and a clumsy elbow.

channels_009.speaker: narrator
channels_009.text: Her first pulse reached the wrist junction and returned with a sharp tick in her middle finger. She stopped. The reservoir still held most of its measured charge, but the finger felt colder than its neighbors. Duan compared both hands, checked ordinary circulation and canceled the next pulse. He gave her a warm cloth and an appointment for the following morning.

channels_010.speaker: lin_yue
channels_010.text: It was barely a quarter-unit. I could hold more than six last week. I expected a small pulse to be too weak to harm me. If reserve does not tell me how much the wrist can pass, what measurement does? I need to know which number to obey before the smallness of the light persuades me to ignore the cold.

channels_011.speaker: duan_zhi
channels_011.text: Throughput and reserve are separate. A cistern may hold more water than its drain can carry. We estimate route throughput from several low pulses, with full recovery between them, then stay below the smallest safe estimate. A quarter-unit may still arrive too quickly. Tonight you use no qi through that wrist. Retention practice can continue without pretending the route is ready.

channels_012.speaker: narrator
channels_012.text: The cold resolved by morning. Duan found no lingering numbness and prescribed two further rest days before a slower attempt. Lin Yue spent them scraping ordinary deposits from a shut-down pool. She watched water spread through a narrow groove: a fast pour spilled over its banks; the same quantity admitted slowly reached the basin. The comparison was useful precisely because water was not qi.

channels_013.speaker: narrator
channels_013.text: During the next session she reduced the input to one eighth of a unit and lengthened its release over three ordinary breaths. The return lens moved late and weakly. Her finger stayed warm. Duan wrote a safe low-flow observation, leaving the completion column empty. Lin Yue looked at the slow return and understood how someone could be tempted to rename impatience as courage.

channels_014.speaker: duan_zhi
channels_014.text: You are not opening the whole pair today. You are finding a flow the first junction tolerates. We will repeat it after sleep, then move to the next junction only if both sides agree. Channels adapt through compatible work and recovery. A dramatic surge can tear a shortcut across a route that later must be repaired in the ordinary slow way.

channels_015.speaker: narrator
channels_015.text: For two weeks the same three breaths carried the same eighth-unit pulse. On some evenings the return arrived sooner; on others it returned with phase grit that the grounding pad caught as a dull halo. Lin Yue noted what she had eaten and which basin she had cleaned. Correlations emerged, disappeared, and refused to become a convenient single explanation.

channels_016.speaker: lin_yue
channels_016.text: The grit is worse after the west basin, but not every time. It might be the basin's residue, or fatigue from its longer shift, or the cold wind there. Could I change the shift while keeping the meal and practice hour the same? I cannot afford enough attempts to vary everything at once, and another guess will only use the fuel.

channels_017.speaker: duan_zhi
channels_017.text: We can schedule that comparison. It will cost us one slower repair morning, which belongs in the workshop account. Your test matters enough to pay that cost, once. Ask a second worker to seal the reference chamber without telling you its position. Then write the prediction before the attempt. A prediction recorded afterward can agree with almost anything.

channels_018.speaker: narrator
channels_018.text: The controlled comparison weakened the basin theory. Grit rose after heavy labor at either pool and stayed lower after seated sorting at the west one. Han Mei inspected the ordinary pulse under Lin Yue's wrist. The result suggested fatigue altered refinement before the channel became painful. It did not prove that the west basin's deposits were harmless; those still went into the lined tray.

channels_019.speaker: han_mei
channels_019.text: We have narrowed one cause for your practice result. The disposal rule answers a different question and remains. When cultivation texts sound certain, ask what their certainty covers. A method safe for a rested examiner may fail in a hungry worker. That is not an inferior soul. It is a method written around a body the author forgot to describe.

channels_020.speaker: narrator
channels_020.text: Lin Yue began labeling each attempt with a recovered or working-day mark. Her notebook looked less heroic and became easier to use. She could compare like with like. The first junction tolerated a slow quarter-unit on three recovered trials. Duan let her continue toward the elbow, where the return would have to cross a scar from an old kiln burn.

channels_021.speaker: duan_zhi
channels_021.text: The scar changes the surface reading. It may also change local tolerance. We test both instead of deciding from appearance. No pill is required merely because the skin has a mark. Show me the ordinary movement first. Then we compare with a contact pad placed clear of the scar and keep the dose beneath the previous safe flow.

channels_022.speaker: narrator
channels_022.text: The altered placement improved the lens reading but did not improve her felt pressure. Duan split those findings in the notebook. A salve eased the old skin's dryness; a longer release eased the route. Neither could claim the other's result. Lin Yue had wanted one cure to remove the scar and every consequence of it. The work gave her two smaller answers she could verify.

channels_023.speaker: narrator
channels_023.text: Shen Qing visited with a sword practice invitation. He demonstrated a narrow bright thread along a grounded blade, then put the blade away when Lin Yue asked whether she could try it. She felt disappointment before she noticed the rated handle and the separate stone socket. His demonstration involved protections she did not yet know how to inspect.

channels_024.speaker: shen_qing
channels_024.text: The blade is a workshop teaching tool. Its socket supplies most of the visible thread. Your first pair is not ready for this grip, and the return pad sits close to your wrist scar. We can practice ordinary alignment with an unpowered wooden blade today. Refusing this particular circuit does not forbid you to learn where your feet belong.

channels_025.speaker: narrator
channels_025.text: They practiced on dry boards. Shen Qing moved her front foot a finger-width and asked her to bend the knee without power. The pressure vanished. Lin Yue had been planning to reinforce a stance that was already twisted. She repeated the ordinary correction until the boards creaked under the same balanced weight. No light appeared. The absence was becoming less embarrassing.

channels_026.speaker: narrator
channels_026.text: In the fourth route week, she woke after a troubled dream and discovered a faint numb line across two fingers. She had practiced within the dose limit, eaten properly, and slept long enough. The uncertainty frightened her more than a known mistake. She carried the notebook to Duan rather than making an unrecorded attempt to reproduce the symptom.

channels_027.speaker: duan_zhi
channels_027.text: We suspend route pulses until the symptom resolves and an independent examiner checks it. You keep your stage-two retention assessment; the pair remains unfinished. Yesterday's low-flow limit may no longer be safe. A limit is a conclusion from known conditions, not an oath that the tissue must obey when new evidence arrives.

channels_028.speaker: narrator
channels_028.text: Han Mei took the next readings while Duan inspected the caliper. A salt bridge had formed beneath one contact pad. It allowed part of the apparent return to pass outside Lin Yue's route. The notebook overstated her throughput. It did not explain away the numbness; a too-fast pulse could still have reached the tissue before the false return convinced them it was complete.

channels_029.speaker: lin_yue
channels_029.text: I cleaned the visible pads every time. I did not know the underside could make a bridge. Your inspection sheet did not name it either. I need the rest now, and we need a better inspection. If we call this only my impatience, the next borrower will make the same careful mistake with the same clean-looking instrument.

channels_030.speaker: duan_zhi
channels_030.text: Agreed. The workshop pays for the independent assessment and the lost scheduled sessions. I will add the underside check and a test with the contacts lifted from the skin. Your report stopped the instrument before another borrower used it. My stage does not excuse a faulty inspection. We repair the tool and our procedure; your wrist still needs its own recovery.

channels_031.speaker: narrator
channels_031.text: The independent examination found temporary irritation, no persistent loss of ordinary sensation. The route rested for eleven days. Lin Yue could maintain a quiet reservoir and do limited sorting, but she missed the sensation of reaching toward the elbow. The promise of third stage had made stage two feel like a waiting room. She read her first overnight failure and found a room with a floor.

channels_032.speaker: han_mei
channels_032.text: Keep the floor. When my shoulder was injured, I treated every surviving skill as a reminder of the one I had lost. It nearly cost me the work I could still do. You are allowed to grieve the lost days. You are also allowed to hold six units reliably without demanding that they apologize for not being twelve.

channels_033.speaker: narrator
channels_033.text: The repaired caliper returned with a second blank and a lifted-contact test. Duan asked Lin Yue to inspect it before watching his own inspection. Their separate notes matched. For the renewed route work, he used a lower dose and a slower release than before. She felt a small return at the elbow without the old cold line, then waited until morning before deciding what it meant.

channels_034.speaker: narrator
channels_034.text: The next-day hand check was normal. Another week established the elbow junction under alternating light work and recovered days. Duan changed the chamber positions, the contact cloth and the hour of practice. Lin Yue could state which changes affected the reference and which affected her. Her explanations became shorter as she needed fewer invented reasons to protect her pride.

channels_035.speaker: duan_zhi
channels_035.text: Now the chest junction. We keep the ordinary breath easy and the return route available. If you feel tightness behind the sternum, stop; a remembered diagram does not overrule that sensation. The first pair will be complete only when the inward and outward paths carry a matched low pulse, release on command, and leave both hands normal after sleep.

channels_036.speaker: narrator
channels_036.text: The inward path reached the chest junction on a still morning. Lin Yue felt a cool turn beside the warmth of her heartbeat. She did not follow it deeper. The manual's next stroke looked temptingly close, a single curve away from an extraordinary vessel. Duan covered that part of the map and asked her to demonstrate the way back first.

channels_037.speaker: lin_yue
channels_037.text: I want the larger circuit badly enough that the next line looks like permission. Today the permission is for this pair. I can name the return junction and stop the pulse before the chest tightens. If I cannot do that when I am excited, the map belongs to my imagination more than to my body.

channels_038.speaker: narrator
channels_038.text: The first complete return cost nearly half a unit to deliver a useful quarter. Some energy dispersed at the junctions; some was caught by the grounding pads. Duan required the loss to remain in the notebook. A completed route did not mean a perfect route. Lin Yue could finally distinguish the promise of future efficiency from the reserve that today's technique actually spent.

channels_039.speaker: duan_zhi
channels_039.text: Third-stage assessment requires twelve usable units after ordinary activity, at least eighty-five percent compatible charge, and the first pair carrying a controlled quarter-unit pulse in both directions. Three recovered trials, with independent blanks and normal next-day sensation. We do not add reserve while pretending the route work costs nothing. Your sleeping field and your waking route must support each other.

channels_040.speaker: narrator
channels_040.text: It took three more weeks to reach the twelve-unit reserve while keeping the route quiet. Lin Yue increased the target by half a unit only after a recovered retention test. When a working day returned less, she reduced the next practice load instead of chasing the missing amount. The workshop ledger recorded sixty-eight days since her arrival. None could be removed by a bright enough exhalation.

channels_041.speaker: narrator
channels_041.text: The first assessment returned twelve and one quarter units at eighty-six percent compatibility. The inward pulse and its outward partner matched within the caliper's permitted delay. Duan asked her to stop halfway through another pulse. She discharged without chest pressure, then spent the remainder of the day sorting ceramic caps. Next morning, both hands felt ordinary.

channels_042.speaker: narrator
channels_042.text: For the second assessment, Han Mei sealed the reference and Duan moved the bench into the shaded shed. Twelve units remained after the overnight and sampling corrections. A passerby dropped a bucket during the route test. Lin Yue interrupted, grounded, and restarted only after the blank settled. Her pair obeyed the stop sooner than her startled heartbeat did.

channels_043.speaker: narrator
channels_043.text: The third assessment followed a light sluice shift, a full supper and a night's sleep in the cooler room. Twelve and one eighth units remained; compatibility was eighty-seven percent. The quarter-unit pulse completed both directions. Lin Yue named the measured loss, released the excess, and returned the borrowed tool. The following morning's sensation check found no numbness.

channels_044.speaker: duan_zhi
channels_044.text: Qi Gathering, third stage: First pair. Your method now permits one prepared reinforced step, within the tested throughput. It does not permit a leap across the canal or a blade thread borrowed from Shen Qing's tool. We will practice the step on dry boards with a slack safety line. A new capability needs its own ordinary conditions.

channels_045.speaker: narrator
channels_045.text: Lin Yue traced the two channel strokes in her notebook. The ink was darker where weeks of corrections had crossed the first neat diagram. She could have recopied it cleanly. Instead she added a second page for the next stage and kept the damaged map. The salt bridge, the eleven rest days and the stopped pulses belonged to the route she had actually earned.
